description: Read an OpenAI-compatible server's model catalogue; callers should list the solet's models through service_interface::embedding_service::list_models.
embedding_description: Read the configured server's /models route and keep the embedder entries, those typed embedding, untyped, or with embed in the id, placing the configured default first when absent. Each carries a name, text input type and description, never a dimension or input limit. Not the solet's general model list.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Available models with keys: models (array of {name, dimension, max_input_length, input_types, description})
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Determine the appropriate next action based on the context and action result.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Lists available embedding models from the OpenAI-compatible API
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: ConnectionError: API endpoint not reachable. APIError: Backend service doesn't support model listing.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: For connection errors: verify the embedding service is running. If model listing is not supported, the configured default model will still be returned.
